utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m sorry, I still don’t have the date, time, or repair list confirmed yet. If you’d like, I can check and get back to you as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Mara — please check and let me know as soon as you have the date, time, and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the date, time, and what repairs the drive is focusing on? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure of the latest details yet—I just know they were asking for volunteers. Did you hear what repairs they’re focusing on?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo — if you can bring a sturdy wrench set and a few spare bolts, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh good, I can bring those. Anything else you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive, Vik—what time are we starting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re starting at 9 Saturday morning, and just bring gloves and a bit of water. I’ll check if Nell’s heard from any new volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, I think it’s still moving along, but I may have missed a few updates. Last I heard, they were still collecting stuff for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Noah—I’ll keep an ear out too and let you know if I hear any updates about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you bring the toolbox to the community center, and then check the north shed for any extra screws?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be great, Gus — a couple of extra tools would really help the repair drive go smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring a couple of extra tools by—what would help most?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Ira—can you confirm if you hear what we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re still gathering tools and a few hands for the heavier fixes—if you find that toolbox, bring it by and you’ll be a lifesaver!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, I’m still hunting for that toolbox—I set it down somewhere clever, apparently. If I find it, I’ll bring it by and help with the porch light or whatever’s next.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep track of the supplies for the repair drive—just tell me what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot—can you also confirm the drop-off timing and location when you have them? I need to plan my route.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still nailing that down, but I’ll send you the drop-off spot and timing as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—send it over when you’ve got it, and I’ll bring a couple of tools by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s coming along nicely — folks are pitching in with tools, time, and a few spare parts already. I’ll keep you posted if anything urgent comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess — glad to hear it’s moving along. Keep me posted if you need a hand.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
